text:
Experts believe that artificial intelligence will change our world in the coming years. Today, we use "narrow AI" for specific tasks, like translating languages or recommending films. The next big step is Artificial General Intelligence, or AGI. This means a machine could think and learn like a human across many different areas.

AGI could bring amazing benefits, such as discovering new medicines or solving climate problems. However, there are also serious risks. Some experts worry that AGI might be difficult to control, or that it could take away millions of jobs. Scientists disagree about when AGI will arrive. Some predict it within twenty years, while others think it is much further away.
